title: Backtest input (robot-domain-rules/3)
description: A recorded event log and the options for replaying it through a rulebook. SPEC.md § 13.

events.description: In time order, as the site recorded them.

outcome.description: What the record says happened after the request. Reported only; never used to decide.

at.description: When it was asked. Reported as given; it is the request's `now` and each built history entry's `at`.

request.description: Exactly what the participant asked. A malformed request is a row refused as missing facts, never an error.

examples.description: How many example timestamps each list keeps (the earliest). Default 3.
